tasks.label: Start Dev with local DB
tasks.detail: Starts local Supabase, resets its database, and runs Vite against the local API on port 5174. The reset deletes local database data.
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; npx supabase start | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; npx supabase db reset --local --no-seed; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $statusJson = npx supabase status --output json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $supabaseStatus = $statusJson | ConvertFrom-Json; if (-not $supabaseStatus.API_URL -or -not $supabaseStatus.ANON_KEY) { throw 'Local Supabase API URL or anon key is missing.' }; $env:VITE_SUPABASE_URL = $supabaseStatus.API_URL; $env:VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = $supabaseStatus.ANON_KEY; Write-Output ('Using local Supabase API at {0}' -f $supabaseStatus.API_URL); npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Stop Dev with local DB
tasks.detail: Stops the local Supabase containers. Use after ending manual testing.

tasks.label: Vue: Stop Dev Server
tasks.detail: Windows: stop only Vite dev servers belonging to this workspace.
args: $projectRoot = $env:VUE_PROJECT_ROOT + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar; $viteScript = [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar + [IO.Path]::Combine('vite', 'bin', 'vite.js'); $servers = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'node.exe'" | Where-Object { if (-not $_.CommandLine) { return $false }; $commandLine = $_.CommandLine.Replace([char]47, [char]92); $commandLine.IndexOf($projectRoot, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $commandLine.IndexOf($viteScript, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $commandLine -notmatch ' (?:build|preview)(?: |$)' }); if ($servers.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'No Vite dev server found for this workspace.' } else { $servers | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Stopped workspace Vite server (PID {0}).' -f $_.ProcessId) } }
